text: Yes now one step further, any of this should just automatically be tossed down ninto a settings interface where i can turn on autosave, turn it off, do whatever, and not have to go dig through code to do so
resolution: Established the settings contract for the upcoming persistence work. Autosave becomes a framework/application setting projected into Preferences and persisted as app configuration, with one shared policy consumed by world, map, globals, and materialized-model writers rather than per-feature booleans. Default is on; off requires dirty state plus Save/Discard/Cancel on document switch, close, and exit, and a real Save command for document types currently relying exclusively on autosave. Hot-update carryover remains a separate reload-policy setting because it preserves ephemeral working state without writing project documents. First-save/atlas ownership remains invariant under every setting. No files changed.
